Badge flags are set on the after stitch of dojo knots only, once, on defeat. Elites never set a badge flag.

lines.speaker: Master Lin
lines.text: You've come far, young trainer.

lines.speaker: Master Lin
lines.text: You've come far, young trainer.

lines.speaker: Master Lin
lines.text: Let us begin.

lines.speaker: Master Lin
lines.text: Your footing is slipping. A core that cracks cannot hold.

lines.speaker: Master Lin
lines.text: One more push... and the core settles this bout.

lines.speaker: Master Lin
lines.text: Well fought. You held your core when it counted.

lines.speaker: Master Lin
lines.text: A strong foundation, tested fairly. You earned this.

lines.speaker: Master Lin

lines.speaker: Master Lin

dojo_2_falk.note: APPROVED 2026-10-26 ~12:01 CDT, all lines verbatim from MASTER-FALK-DIALOGUE-DRAFT-2026-10-26.md. Not redrafted.

lines.speaker: Master Falk
lines.text: Hey, hey, welcome up here. I'm Master Falk, and I'm high as a kite today, so you better keep up.

lines.speaker: Master Falk
lines.text: Hey, hey, welcome up here. I'm Master Falk, and I'm high as a kite today, so you better keep up.

lines.speaker: Master Falk
lines.text: You made it to my Dojo? Good. I live free like a bird up here, no cage, no chain, just wind.

lines.speaker: Master Falk
lines.text: The winds favor the swift! So show me you're swift, or get blown right back down.

lines.speaker: Master Falk
lines.text: Oh, you're drifting now. I'm about to fly him out, straight off this mountain.

lines.speaker: Master Falk
lines.text: Feel that? That's the wind picking you up. I'm about to fly him out.

lines.speaker: Master Falk
lines.text: Free like a bird, and you? You're just a feather in a storm.

lines.speaker: Master Falk
lines.text: Ha! Okay, okay, you clipped my wings. I'm high as a kite, but you flew higher.

lines.speaker: Master Falk
lines.text: Free like a bird, and today that bird is you. Take the wind with you.

lines.speaker: Master Falk
lines.text: Here's your Wind Fragment. Hold it tight, or the wind will take it.

lines.speaker: Master Falk
lines.text: Next Dojo's down the road, not up in the clouds. Don't get too comfortable on the ground, though. Stay free, stay fast.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Welcome to Neon City. I am Tetsu, and this dojo runs like good steel: steady, tested, and true.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Welcome to Neon City. I am Tetsu, and this dojo runs like good steel: steady, tested, and true.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Chrome is not about shine. It is about holding your shape when everything presses down on you.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Show me a team that holds together under pressure, and I will show you respect. Let us begin.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: There it is. The pressure is building, and your line is starting to bend.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Steel does not rush. It waits... and then it holds. You are running out of room.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Well struck. My steel bent today, and it bent clean.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: You kept your shape when it counted. That is the whole lesson.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Take the Neon Fragment. Keep it polished, and keep it honest.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Market City is your next stop. The Strike dojo there hits harder than it looks, so go ready.

dojo_4_kenji.note: Staged draft from dialogue-drafts.json, carried forward unchanged. NOT locked canon.

lines.speaker: Kenji
lines.text: Welcome to Market City. I am Kenji, and here we train the way traders work: every move must earn its place.

lines.speaker: Kenji
lines.text: Welcome to Market City. I am Kenji, and here we train the way traders work: every move must earn its place.

lines.speaker: Kenji
lines.text: Strike is discipline. No wasted motion, no wild swings, just the right hit at the right moment.

lines.speaker: Kenji
lines.text: Bow, breathe, and show me your form. Then we fight.

lines.speaker: Kenji
lines.text: Your guard is slipping. One clean opening is all a trained fighter needs.

lines.speaker: Kenji
lines.text: See? The bout turns on a single breath... and yours just ran short.

lines.speaker: Kenji
lines.text: A clean loss. You read my rhythm and broke it fairly.

lines.speaker: Kenji
lines.text: Good. A fighter who learns from a win like that is already stronger.

lines.speaker: Kenji
lines.text: The Strike Fragment is yours. Carry it the way you carry a win: lightly, and with respect.

lines.speaker: Kenji
lines.text: Central City waits next, and its dojo keeps to the shadows. Walk in with your eyes open.

dojo_5_phantom.note: Staged draft from dialogue-drafts.json, carried forward unchanged. NOT locked canon. Name PHANTOM locked 2026-10-26; superseded name never used.

lines.speaker: PHANTOM
lines.text: You have come to Central City, to a dojo where the lights stay low. I am Phantom.

lines.speaker: PHANTOM
lines.text: You have come to Central City, to a dojo where the lights stay low. I am Phantom.

lines.speaker: PHANTOM
lines.text: Behind this mask is a samurai of the night. I do not fight for show. I fight for honor, in shadow.

lines.speaker: PHANTOM
lines.text: The Umbral way is patience. Strike from stillness, vanish, and strike again. Face me if you dare.

lines.speaker: PHANTOM
lines.text: The shadows are closing in now. Your team is down to its last light.

lines.speaker: PHANTOM
lines.text: One more step in the dark... and the night claims this bout.

lines.speaker: PHANTOM
lines.text: The mask does not fall, but the samurai bows. You fought well in the dark.

lines.speaker: PHANTOM
lines.text: You did not fear the shadows. You walked straight through them.

lines.speaker: PHANTOM
lines.text: Take the Umbral Fragment. Wear its lesson well: stillness is a weapon too.

lines.speaker: PHANTOM
lines.text: Harbor City is next. Its dojo rides the tide, and the tide does not wait for anyone.

lines.speaker: Shizuku
lines.text: Welcome to Harbor City. I am Shizuku, and the harbor is my dojo.

lines.speaker: Shizuku
lines.text: Welcome to Harbor City. I am Shizuku, and the harbor is my dojo.

lines.speaker: Shizuku
lines.text: Water wins by never stopping. A wave does not argue with a wall. It just keeps coming.

lines.speaker: Shizuku
lines.text: I train my team the way the tide trains the shore: steady, sure, and impossible to ignore. Ready?

lines.speaker: Shizuku
lines.text: Feel that? The tide is turning, and it is turning my way.

lines.speaker: Shizuku
lines.text: One more wave... and your team is washed out to sea.

lines.speaker: Shizuku
lines.text: Ha! All right, the harbor yields today. You surfed that bout beautifully.

lines.speaker: Shizuku
lines.text: You rode every wave I sent and never wiped out. That takes real nerve.

lines.speaker: Shizuku
lines.text: Here, the Water Fragment. Keep it close, and let it remind you to keep moving.

lines.speaker: Shizuku
lines.text: Ember Island is your next crossing. Its dojo burns bright, so bring your cool head with you.

dojo_7_homura.note: Staged draft from dialogue-drafts.json, carried forward unchanged. NOT locked canon.

lines.speaker: Homura
lines.text: Welcome to Ember Island! I am Homura, and this dojo burns from the heart out.

lines.speaker: Homura
lines.text: Welcome to Ember Island! I am Homura, and this dojo burns from the heart out.

lines.speaker: Homura
lines.text: Flame is passion with discipline. A wild fire burns out fast. A tended fire burns all night.

lines.speaker: Homura
lines.text: My team burns bright and true, and we do not dim for anyone. Show me your spark!

lines.speaker: Homura
lines.text: There it goes, your team is flickering! One more push and the flame takes this bout.

lines.speaker: Homura
lines.text: Feel the heat rising... This is where a fire either catches or goes out.

lines.speaker: Homura
lines.text: Whew! You blew right through my best fire and came out shining.

lines.speaker: Homura
lines.text: A loss like that just feeds the flame. You earned this one, truly.

lines.speaker: Homura
lines.text: Take the Flame Fragment, and keep its fire banked, not blazing wild.

lines.speaker: Homura
lines.text: One dojo stands between you and the Plateau road, in Silicon Town. Go, and burn bright.

lines.text: So you made it through all eight dojos. I am Umi, first seat of the Elite Four.

lines.speaker: Umi
lines.text: So you made it through all eight dojos. I am Umi, first seat of the Elite Four.

lines.text: Swim or sink, challenger. Let us see which one you are.

lines.text: The deep water is pulling you under now. Your last stand is showing.

lines.speaker: Gin
lines.text: I am Gin, second seat. You beat the water, so now you face the metal beneath it.

lines.speaker: Hono
lines.text: I am Hono, third seat, and I keep the fire of the Plateau.

lines.text: By now you have felt every kind of heat. Mine is the kind that tests the heart, not just the team.

lines.speaker: Hono
lines.text: Burn steady, challenger, or burn out. There is no middle flame here.

lines.speaker: Hono

lines.speaker: Yoru
lines.text: I am Yoru, fourth seat, last door before the Plateau road.

lines.speaker: Yoru
lines.text: Umbral at this height is not a trick. It is the night itself: patient, silent, and everywhere at once.

lines.speaker: Yoru
lines.text: If your team still stands after my night, then you are ready for what lies beyond. Face me.

lines.speaker: Yoru
lines.text: Night is falling on your team now. The last light is going out.

lines.speaker: Yoru
lines.text: One more shadow... and the night closes this bout.

lines.speaker: Yoru

lines.speaker: Iwao
lines.text: I am Iwao. I work stone the way a mould works clay: slow, sure, and once.

lines.speaker: Iwao
lines.text: I am Iwao. I work stone the way a mould works clay: slow, sure, and once.

lines.speaker: Iwao
lines.text: A rock does not hurry. It holds. My team holds the same way.

lines.speaker: Iwao
lines.text: Show me a team that can move a mountain without breaking it. Then we fight.

lines.speaker: Iwao
lines.text: Your team is wearing down against the stone now. One more crack... and the mould holds.

lines.speaker: Iwao
lines.text: Feel that weight? That is the mountain settling.

lines.speaker: Iwao
lines.text: Stone can be moved. You just proved it, clean and fair.

lines.speaker: Iwao
lines.text: A mould breaks only when the shape inside is stronger. Yours was.

lines.speaker: Iwao
lines.text: You earned more than a win today. You earned a shape that holds.

lines.speaker: Iwao
lines.text: Take that shape with you. Wherever I stand next, you will know it when you see it.

lines.speaker: Jax
lines.text: Well, well, well! Look who walked right into my show! I am Jax, and this is my stage!

lines.speaker: Jax
lines.text: Well, well, well! Look who walked right into my show! I am Jax, and this is my stage!

lines.speaker: Jax
lines.text: You thought the Syndicate was all shadows and locked doors? No, no, no... we put on a show first. Then we win.

lines.speaker: Jax
lines.text: I will even give you a head start. Not because I am kind. Because it makes the ending funnier.

lines.speaker: Jax
lines.text: Oh, this is the good part! You are down to your last one, and the crowd... well, the crowd is me, and I am loving this.

lines.speaker: Jax

lines.speaker: Jax

lines.speaker: Jax

lines.speaker: Jax
lines.text: Take your win. Enjoy it. I will be back with a bigger stage and a sharper team.

lines.speaker: Jax
lines.text: And next time, I will not be funny first. I will be funny after.

lines.text: Howdy, partner! Name's Cowboy Farmer Bob, thirty years old, finest farmer this side of anywhere!

lines.text: Well, blow me down! A challenger on my ferry route! I am the Ferry Captain, and this sea answers to me.

lines.text: Ladies and gentlemen, challengers and dreamers, welcome to my stage! I am Hoshino, and the stars came out for you tonight!

lines.speaker: Shopkeeper

lines.text: Luigi Cubes, 250 CR each. The lab sends every new trainer out with five, and we keep the rest stocked here.

lines.speaker: Shopkeeper

lines.speaker: Townspeople
